objectives.text: Fight your way through the woods before the kidnappers escape
Kill the Dark Adept before more elves arrive

intro_messages.speaker: Arvith
intro_messages.message: Come on, men. A stroll through such lovely green woods, what could be finer?
intro_messages.message_fr: Allons, mes hommes. Une promenade à travers de si jolis bois verdoyants, quoi de plus agréable ?

intro_messages.speaker: Nil-Galion
intro_messages.message: You there! Halt and explain yourself.

intro_messages.speaker: Arvith
intro_messages.message: We’re chasing after some men who kidnapped my brother!
intro_messages.message_fr: Nous poursuivons des hommes qui ont enlevé mon frère !

intro_messages.speaker: Nil-Galion
intro_messages.message: Those men caught their prisoner practicing necromancy; for your sake, I hope he was not your brother. Assume that the man they caught was your brother’s murderer, and rest assured that the grey mages will release all of the souls that their prisoner’s evil magic has bound to this world.
intro_messages.message_fr: Ces hommes ont surpris leur prisonnier en train de pratiquer la nécromancie ; pour votre bien, j'espère que ce n'était pas votre frère. Considérez que l'homme qu'ils ont capturé est l'assassin de votre frère, et soyez assuré que les mages gris libéreront toutes les âmes que la magie maléfique de leur prisonnier a liées à ce monde.

intro_messages.speaker: Arvith
intro_messages.message: We killed the necromancer on the battlefield! I saw the killing blow with my own eyes.
intro_messages.message_fr: Nous avons tué le nécromancien sur le champ de bataille ! J'ai vu le coup fatal de mes propres yeux.

intro_messages.speaker: Nil-Galion
intro_messages.message:
We heard the sounds of battle three days ago, but the foul reek of death was unmistakable as the prisoner passed us; if your brother really is the prisoner then he is also a necromancer. Remember your brother as we all hope he was, and know that the prisoner’s fate will be revenge as dire as you could wish.

Either way, nothing will be gained by your intrusion into our woods. Now advance no further, for we will defend our land.
intro_messages.message_fr:
Nous avons entendu les bruits de la bataille il y a trois jours, mais l'infâme relent de la mort était sans équivoque lorsque le prisonnier est passé près de nous ; si votre frère est vraiment le prisonnier, alors il est également nécromancien. Souvenez-vous de votre frère tel que nous espérons tous qu'il était, et sachez que le sort du prisonnier sera une vengeance aussi terrible que vous pourriez le souhaiter.

Dans tous les cas, rien ne sera gagné par votre intrusion dans nos bois. N'avancez pas plus loin, car nous défendrons notre terre.

intro_messages.speaker: Arvith
intro_messages.message: So much for those ghost stories, but even ghosts might have been more observant than these elves. Still, they will not stop me from freeing Baran!
intro_messages.message_fr: Voilà pour ces histoires de fantômes, mais même des fantômes auraient sans doute été plus observateurs que ces elfes. Cela dit, ils ne m'empêcheront pas de libérer Baran !

intro_messages.message: I am glad at least that we will not have to face ghosts. But those elves will have us at a disadvantage; our horses will not maneuver well in the trees.
intro_messages.message_fr: Je suis au moins content que nous n'ayons pas à affronter des fantômes. Mais ces elfes nous mettront en position de faiblesse ; nos chevaux ne manœuvreront pas bien parmi les arbres.

intro_messages.speaker: Arvith
intro_messages.message: Bah, just stay on the paths; our spearmen and bowmen can fight in the deeper woods. We have faced and won through greater perils than those amateurs can offer.
intro_messages.message_fr: Bah, restez simplement sur les chemins ; nos piquiers et nos archers peuvent combattre au cœur des bois. Nous avons affronté et surmonté de plus grands périls que ce que ces amateurs peuvent offrir.

a.speaker: second_unit
a.message: I see them! There they are!

a.speaker: Muff Toras
a.message: Curses! Had they been a few hours slower, I might have covered our tracks without arousing the elves’ suspicions. Still, no need for the disguise any more.

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: Well, elves? Now do you see who the necromancers are?

a.speaker: messenger_elf
a.message: I heard sounds of battle, but did not expect to see this. I will inform the Council, they can work out who the necromancers are.

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: Come on, men, let’s catch those kidnappers!

a.speaker: unit
a.message: Hah! You have captured me, but it will avail you nothing. I sent your precious brother the mage north with half my men a day since; he will be safely locked away in our master’s dungeons by now.

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: My blade is at your throat. Give us the way to my brother now, or I will spill your wretched blood on the ground.

a.speaker: unit
a.message: Three days ride to the northeast, in a deserted castle. The passwords to the guards are $first_password_$first_password and $second_password_$second_password|.

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: Bind him and take him with us. If he has played us false, he will die.
Captain, what are we riding into? I thought you wanted nothing to do with Baran any more, not since Toen Caric.

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: I’m no longer sure. What’s between us remains, but knowing someone else has lain hands on him changes things. Mount up, and let’s get moving.

a.speaker: Nil-Galion
a.message: Deluded fool, you are rescuing a necromancer. I can only hope that you are too late, and that our souls will rest in peace.

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: All is lost now that I am dead...

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: These elves have delayed us too long, the kidnappers’ trail will have faded by now.

a.speaker: Arvith
a.message: More elves are arriving; even if they believe me, the kidnappers’ trail is sure to fade before we can follow.
